title: Edge saved passwords
whyItMatters: Holds every username and password saved in Edge. The values are encrypted with the Windows account, but scripts that can run as that user can decrypt them.
source: Chromium user data directory docs, profile files include Login Data (Edge uses this layout): https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: One Login Data file per profile. Work profiles may also sync these passwords to a Microsoft 365 account.
